content.text: No indemnity exists anywhere in the document. Let me validate an insertion into § 7 after the liability caps.

input.summary: Insert a Contractor (Vendor) indemnity covering third-party IP infringement, breach of law, Contractor-caused data breach and gross negligence/wilful misconduct, with standard claim procedure and carve-out from the § 7(a) cap.
input.comment: [Playbook] Section 7 is titled "Indemnification of Contractor" but the Agreement contains no indemnity at all, and the Section 5(c) non-infringement warranty gives us no right to a defence if a third party sues us over the Works. We have added a Contractor indemnity for third-party IP claims, breach of law, Contractor-caused data incidents and gross negligence or wilful misconduct, with a standard notice-and-control procedure; if you prefer, we can narrow this to the IP indemnity with the usual modification/combination exclusions and a 3x annual fees super-cap.

ops.text: (d) Contractor shall defend, indemnify and hold harmless Company and its affiliates from and against any third-party claim, and all resulting damages, costs and expenses (including reasonable attorneys' fees), to the extent arising out of (i) an allegation that the Services or the Works infringe or misappropriate any intellectual property right; (ii) Contractor's breach of applicable law; (iii) any unauthorized access to or disclosure of Company data or Confidential Information caused by Contractor; or (iv) Contractor's gross negligence or wilful misconduct. Company shall provide Contractor with prompt written notice of the claim, sole control of the defense and settlement thereof (provided that Contractor shall not settle any claim in a manner that imposes any obligation or admission on Company without Company's prior written consent), and reasonable cooperation at Contractor's expense. Contractor's obligations under this Section 7(d) shall not be subject to the limitation of liability set forth in Section 7(a), and the waiver of attorneys' fees in Section 7(c) shall not apply to this Section 7(d).
